notes: 18 debug-decision cases. Eval method: a subagent applies SKILL.md to each prompt and returns {fires, decision, layer, special}, graded vs expected. Covers trigger-vs-defer (defers to coding / perf-audit / security-audit / code-review / ui-review / visual-regression), Phase-2 layer routing (backend vs ui vs perf-reactive), and two special behaviors: needs-instance (UI symptom, no instance -> NEEDS_NEXT: odoo-instance, never ask the user to paste) and expected-log (a deny-path/guard/constraint WARNING in a test run is EXPECTED noise -> no code investigation). Key discriminator pair: id 6 (reactive 'slow right now' -> debug/perf-reactive) vs id 18 (advisory 'should I add index' -> proactive perf-audit). Baseline (pre-optimize snapshot) scored 18/18 - decision logic already robust; this eval is shipped as a decision-regression guard (the skill had none). It does NOT run a live diagnosis or grade a real root cause.
